mapper.select: SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id ORDER BY so.sales_order_id DESC

SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id WHERE so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}
SELECT soi.product_unit_id AS "productUnitId", soi.ordered_qty AS "orderedQty" FROM sales_order_item soi WHERE soi.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} ORDER BY soi.line_no

SELECT p.company_id AS "companyId", p.product_id AS "productId", pu.conversion_qty AS "conversionQty", p.tax_type AS "taxType" FROM product_unit pu JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id WHERE pu.product_unit_id = #{productUnitId} AND pu.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order ( company_id, order_no, customer_id, warehouse_id, order_status, shipment_status, total_supply_amount, total_tax_amount, total_amount, created_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{warehouseId}, 'DRAFT', 'NOT_SHIPPED', #{totalSupplyAmount}, #{totalTaxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO sales_order_item ( sales_order_id, line_no, product_id, product_unit_id, ordered_qty, conversion_qty, base_ordered_qty, shipped_qty, unit_price, tax_type, supply_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, version, created_by ) VALUES ( #{salesOrderId}, #{lineNo}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productUnitId}, #{item.orderedQty}, #{item.conversionQty}, #{item.baseOrderedQty}, 0, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.taxType}, #{item.supplyAmount}, #{item.taxAmount}, #{item.totalAmount}, 0, #{createdBy} )
